#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF now.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is right there.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's go back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and rest.

Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Obtained
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained
I lighty touch the Relief before me.

It feels cold to the touch.
Apparently this Relief is #C236196003Rani#CDEF's mind itself,
but I wonder if #C236196003Rani#CDEF's mind is cold like this Relief.

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So keep moving forward.
Stay here.
Checkpoint unlocked.

Let us search as deep as we can.
Be careful not to miss any clues.

That's #C236196003Rani#CDEF's True Self――
Clearly, the Core of the Labyrinth.

The goal already? This is nothing but a trap.
Darling, be careful.
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.

#C236196003Rani#CDEF must understand this, so why did she
shape the Labyrinth like this?

The reason is obvious. I have no #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Thus, there's no reason to hide or fight.
Nyahaha. That's what this girl said last time.

―――Let me be frank:
your gradual progress ends here,
#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF.

Gh… You need to humiliate #C236196003Rani#CDEF somehow,
#C236196003#NICK#CDEF!
A girl without secrets doesn't exist!

Totally. Such a shame about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.
Be honest, you had mo' #C000246204SGs#CDEF, right?
G-gh… Whose side are you two on!?
I nod, "Yeah, it is."

For a second, #C236196003Rani#CDEF's eyes looked like amethysts
as they sparkled with joy like a child.
Want the chess set?
Do you like chess?

I don't want it. I have my own chess set.
It's in good taste for a woman of science
to have.

Did you know?
India holds some of the oldest known origins
of chess in the world.

My nationality isn't of India, but my
mentor who created me seemed to have an
attachment to that country.

By the way… If you have this much free time,
then how about playing a game with me?
I'm pretty free as well right now.
…an unexpected offer.

I shouldn't need to mention this, but if
you win, you won't be able to obtain an #C000246204SG#CDEF.
This is just a demonstration.

To do so, a fair and impartial game is
preferable.

Reflexes, stamina―no impact. Starting on equal
terms. Plays made only through the fluidity of
our thought. It's the universe's fairest game.

A fair game, huh… but we just don't have the
time for it.
On average, it takes an hour to play.

It's hard to think that this is anything
but a strategy to waste our time.

No matter how long we take, the passage of time
in reality will be negligible. We can freely
immerse ourselves in thought experiments.

Beautiful choice.
Then let's start without delay.
L-lost in ONE SECOND!?
And she loses in ONE SECOND!
#C236196003Saber#CDEF is talking tough, but her exhausted voice says it all.
Certainly. I'll take any challenger.
Hmmm.
Exaggerating, I see.

Oh, boy… I really feel like passing on this
one, but I have to vindicate my Darling
of this disgrace.

So then, #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
Will you grant me a single game?

I knew I would give up after an hour. Hmm.
There would be a bit more thinking involved if
this was Go; but AI are unrivaled in chess.

The vain #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF spits out,
arms firmly crossed.
………well, easy to say―from the sidelines.

NO WAY! That gildy guy is actually SMART!?
Does he not think at human speed!?

It's my loss.
However, it was an obvious thing.

The result was loss after loss.
Even #C236196003Leo#CDEF was unable to topple #C236196003Rani#CDEF's king.
…are there no more challengers?

None.
There's no way anyone around here has an
optimal strategy to beat you.

None.
There's no way anyone other than #C236196003Gil#CDEF has an
optimal strategy to beat you.

Hoooolllddd iitttt!
You're not facing #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF THIS time!
Umm… #C236196003Leo#CDEF? Is this okay?

Why not?
There's no penalty if he loses this game.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF may have a chance to win.

Bleh… It might be true if #C236196003Leo#CDEF
says so, but…… really?

On my pride as a human player,
I won't be losing to an AI just yet.

This one was rather lengthy…!
Who won? #C236196003Rani#CDEF or #C236196003Shinji#CDEF!?
Did he―――really beat her!?

……that was quite a game.
On a best-of-three point system,
I won two straight games.
Ooof course.

Mhm. So my kingliness detector
WAS malfunctioning.

The legendary Game Champ "UME" said those
words too…!

It was worth seeing this unexpected side of
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF, but our situation still hasn't changed.

Yep. I'll be winning by objective judgement,
not subjective. If I get lucky, of course.

#C236196003Rani#CDEF, I heard that you said, "chess is
the ultimate game," but a game like chess
is unequal, see?

What are you saying?
Chess is a fair, equal game.

It's unequal, yo. No matter how "even"
a game's system is, the players going at it
have different levels of skill.

………#C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF.
If you insist so, then let's have a match
in a game YOU consider fair.

……………that's brooding, alright.
The point #C236196003Jinako#CDEF made antithesizes #C236196003Leo#CDEF.

That means #C236196003Rani#CDEF won. In total, #C236196003Rani#CDEF dominated.
She proved that she has luck AND is invincible.

And yet―――
Why does she look so frustrated, I wonder…?

…that absolutely can't be.
I play fair games!
Another 200 rounds, then?

That chess set was on this floor. The one game
you specialize in, or rather, you always win at,
and you purposefully laid it out for us～

Not having an #C000246204SG#CDEF is total BS. This floor itself
is your mind, #C236196003Rani#CDEF. #C236196003#NICK#CDEF, tell it to
her straight up.
Aa, aaah, ah―――!

Nyahaha! This is #C236196003Rani#CDEF's final #C000246204SG#CDEF…
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF hereby dubs this, [#C000246204Powergamer#CDEF]!

That's… my final secret.
…I see. I still had a bias I was unable
to analyze.

…fine then. I will admit that I
craved the spotlight.
However―――

Oh boy… the final #C236196003Rani#CDEF went totally ballistic…
"Powergamer" is quite a dishonorable
title, huh…

Yes, no doubt. However, to break that wall
we must beat #C236196003Rani#CDEF and sever her free from #C236196003BB#CDEF.
Enter Rani's mind now.
Prepare some more.

I understand. #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.
Just like before, please give your support.

Yes, please leave it to me. I've grasped onto
#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF's biograph and soulgraph.

Then as soon as you're ready, please come to me.
I'll wait for you here.

Welcome back.
That was a deft subdual.

I shall take her to the old school.
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, please continue on further.

Yes. Allow my Praetor to secure the exit.
Take care of #C236196003Rani#CDEF, #C236196003Sessyoin#CDEF.
…that's right.

You cannot carry any more
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

You may now save your current game data
            as #C000246204Clear Data#CDEF.

         como #C000246204Clear Data#CDEF.

Are you sure you wish to exit

linhas.en: without saving the Clear Data?

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's keep moving forward!

#C236196003BB#CDEF's within our reach.
Let's keep moving forward.

What―why are you returning?
You've made it this far.
Why stop from going to the end?
Return to the previous floor?
Return to previous floor.
Return to the old school.
Continue to the next floor?
Continue to the next floor.

I need to get #C236196003Rani#CDEF out of this #RUBS     Relief#RUBEmental wall#REND
as soon as possible. I solemnly swore to do so.
Return to the old school?
Praetor, how about we explore a bit further inside?

A search with no leads, huh? Careful not to
tire yourself out from too many battles.

Hmm, well there's a path over there.
Should we give that a shot?

Seems the path forward is blocked. We can
explore more or head back. Do as you see fit.

"I don't have any secrets," huh.
I really don't believe that…

#C236196003Rani#CDEF is standing here all alone…
Behind her―just like with #C236196003Rin#CDEF―is a wall the shape of #C236196003Rani#CDEF.

Yes. This is far too easy. Thinking about how
she acted until now, #C236196003Rani#CDEF doesn't seem like the
type of woman to show her mind so easily.

…what's going on? She doesn't seem like the
type to expose her Core and make it defenseless.

Ho? Her clothes are not the only things which
are bold; her plans are too. I see from this
formation that she is very confident.

There's one #C000246204SG#CDEF left.
Like with #C236196003Rin#CDEF, once I extract #C236196003Rani#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF,
I'll be able to invade the Labyrinth's Core―#C236196003Rani#CDEF's mind.

…I miscalculated on the things I did on the
upper floors. I can't believe I had
such… surplus subroutines.

However, that surplus has sold out. This time,
I don't have a single weak spot. This Labyrinth
is proof of that.

If you want to find my weak spot, then
try all you like. I'll even unlock these doors.

I no longer have any secrets. Therefore, there's
no #C000246204SG#CDEF. If there's no #C000246204SG#CDEF, you won't be able to
break through this wall.

Asserting that, #C236196003Rani#CDEF then takes her eyes off of us.
Her behavior says that she's lost interest.
……an #C000246204SG#CDEF is the mind's weak point.

Up until now, we found clues through discussion.
Now that she's intentionally keeping quiet,
our only option left is to search the Labyrinth.

I thought it might come to this. #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF,
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's not hostile to you, so it's not unusual.
Even I would do the same to protect myself.

Why are you admiring her? Do whatever it takes
to shake #C236196003Rani#CDEF up! If words won't rile her up,
then you'll have to take action, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!

…only you would be so violent, Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF.
However, I won't move an inch. Even if you
attack, I'll offer my life without resistance.

If I disappear here, then that will mean your
defeat. You'll lose the ability to break
through this wall forever.

Hahaha. If Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF says so, then it's
pretty convincing. Whatever she says next will
sound practically villainous.

…let's leave the third party to their adventure.
Anyway, we need to find a clue…

You never learn your lesson, do you?
I told you that I won't… oh.
Could what you're holding be a #C000246204chess set#CDEF?

…let me think.
If I had to say whether I like it or hate it,
I would say I like it.

#C236196003Rani#CDEF, who wouldn't get provoked no matter what
we did, came out and asked us to play a game
all on her own. I'm surprised.

I have to ascertain my own accuracy by
competing with external, thinking subroutines.

Don't worry about that.
If we do play chess, then I will take
the other player to a private playroom.

It's an accelerated space created to play chess.
Though only for thoughts, it can contract time
by a factor of 10 cubed… a thousand times.

―――This may be our chance.
#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, play a game with her.
It might even expose #C236196003Rani#CDEF's weak points.

I agree with #C236196003Rin#CDEF's proposal.
There's nothing to risk if we lose,
so I went along with #C236196003Rani#CDEF and accepted.

I'm not THAT familiar with chess,
but maybe I'll get the hang of it if I play.

That's not it.
I didn't lose in a second.

In that chess playroom―――AKA #C236196003Rani#CDEF's hobby space,
countless struggles to the death unfolded.
Technically, I held out for AT LEAST one second. AT LEAST!

Praetor… you're frustrated enough to have
repeated that twice…

Very well! Now it's my turn!
I will dispel my Master's humiliation.
Praetor, wait but three minutes for me!

N-no, I just… went easy on her…
I wasn't trying even a fraction of my hardest…
Next time I'll go all out… I really will…

One second is approximately 10 minutes, huh…
You got routed.

It's upsetting to think that this is our level
of skill. #C236196003Rani#CDEF. Servants have the right to
challenge you to a game as well, right?

Very well. Then watch carefully, Master.
I'll show you the tactical prowess I've
cultivated over many years.

*kgh*… I was so close…
You won that battle by a hair, #C236196003Rani#CDEF. But this is
good enough for me… I have no regrets…

…………what do you mean?
Time taken aside, I enjoyed the match with
#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF more.

This is absurd. You finally had your chance,
and you squander it. How utterly useless
you are, mongrel.

………what's with that look?
I won't partake.

………all talk………
The #C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF is all talk………

――Unbelievable. #C236196003Rani#CDEF, open the gate.
I'll play, for my amusement.

I won't be trying seriously, but you must
try to your full extent. I will judge
any leniency to be disrespect.

Your concerns are unnecessary.
When it comes to chess, I have no concept
of "going easy."

They took a full five seconds…
Is it a tie due to going overtime?

…no, I was totally defeated.
I was on the defensive ever since mid-game.

Don't be mistaken, miser.
The moment one looks ahead, they've already
been defeated.

The board is not for predicting the future.
It's for looking at from above.
I always look at the correct move.

I don't mind for even a card game next. Though
the worst game to fight me equally in is one
where you "hope to get the hand you want."

Q-quite a different way of looking at it… as
one would expect from Mr. Gold. I can only
imagine that he can "see" a few levels ahead.

The gap in our abilities was clear from the
start. It would actually be strange if I won.
Thus, this one doesn't count.

Since I personally anticipated this outcome,
it was difficult to gain any satisfaction.
So, is anyone else interested in playing?
…some time later.

Not just us, but #C236196003Leo#CDEF, #C236196003Rin#CDEF, #C236196003Sakura#CDEF, and even
#C236196003Gawain#CDEF competed with #C236196003Rani#CDEF across their signal.

…she's right. I ascertained that from a
single bout. As far as chess goes, I'm far and
away from #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
#C236196003Leo#CDEF announcing our defeat was the final nail in the coffin.
They're saying we can't win with who we have here, huh…

Excluding #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF, it looks like it'll be
tough to beat #C236196003Rani#CDEF with the people we have here…

Now then, please take your leave.
―――Ahhh. Playing a fair game is the
most wonderful feeling.

So you wish to re-challenge me?
Very well.
Then let's go to the private playroom and…

I'll lay it right on you: you'll be facing
the feared player of Asia, "Kirinboy."
Here's a special welcome from ME, #C236196003Rani VIII#CDEF!

…a message to everyone in the Student Council
Room: why conduct such foolishness?

Eh? #C236196003Shinji#CDEF!? When did you get on the bench!?
Hey, that's the treasurer's seat!

Hahaha! Don't get so flustered, #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF.
Don't go swooning from watching my super
play from the front row鷙

Just leave it to me. I learned the basics
of chess from my father when I was
five years old.

…very well. If that's how you feel, then I
won't back down. Off to the playroom then.
Let's have a fair game.

Just about 10 seconds.
For them, more than two hours.
Could this have been a huge upset―――!?

An unprecedented new record…!
Could that scrubby kelp have really pulled
it off, or was it all for naught!?
Faint hints of fatigue can be seen in #C236196003Rani#CDEF's eyes.
Looks like we got our hopes up.

Still no! However, a splendid effort, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF!
I have just a slightly better opinion of you!

Yeah, right. Saw that punchline from a mile
away. You're just what we expected, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.
In more ways than one鷙

*kgh*. It's not over! One more set!
It's not my loss until I win!
The will to keep on winning is important!

Continue playing?
As long as the game is fair,
I'll accept challengers, but…

Is that really what you want, player #C236196003Shinji#CDEF?
You should be sensible enough to tell
how good we both are from those two rounds.

You're two games behind me.
If you were one behind,
you could win in the third round.

But if you can't catch two games up to me,
then you'll never be able to win,
no matter how many rounds we play.

Over the transmission, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF can be heard
grinding his teeth over his resentment.

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF may be unreasonable, but he's not
the type of person who doesn't understand logic.

Taking #C236196003Rani#CDEF's point, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF lets out a deep sigh
and accepts his defeat.

…I hate to say it, but you're right.
Good game, #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
Let's play an action game next time.

Over the transmission, the sound of someone
leaving their seat could be heard.
It sounds like #C236196003Shinji#CDEF left the
Student Council Room with good sportsmanship.

Aren't there any other players around
who could stand a chance of beating #C236196003Rani#CDEF…?

So you wish to re-challenge me?
Very well.
Then let's go to the private playroom and…

Ahh, hold up a sec'…
News flash to the "fair game" fetishist there:
#C236196003Rani#CDEF will be facing against #C236196003Jinako#CDEF～

…#C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF… I have no data on you,
but you are one of the Masters who safely
escaped to the old school, yes?

You will be my opponent?
Judging by appearance,
you look like a mediocre player…

Nyahahaha.
It sure does sting to hear a genius Master drop
truth bombs so nonchalantly.

But I'll take it on the chin, just this once.
After all―――once this game is over, #C236196003RANI#CDEF is
the one who's going to be crying, mortified.

…you? Be victorious over me?
Did you perhaps mean that you won't lose,
in terms of emotions?

…your thinking is much too shallow. Chess is
the most fair and equal game in this world.
Luck is not a factor which is involved.

In the first place, saying things such as,
"I'll win if I get lucky" is itself proof that
you're third-rate.

―――Hm, well. You know, I'll admit that chess
is a fair game, but I don't think it's
actually equal.

Two players abandon luck and compete through
the precision of their thought subroutines under
the same rules… What's unequal about this?

Wh――what are you talking about?
Of course players have different skill levels.
Isn't that why one practices?

There are gaps that can't be closed even if you
practice. This applies to everything. That's
why―――nothing is even in this world.

Games are the most extreme example.
The more perfect a system is, the more the
main aspect centers around a player's skill.

Get it? If you wanna praise fairness, then you
